endernium.configuration.enderniumSwordDa: Normal sword damage required to earn each stored barrage strike, as a multiplier of the sword's base damage.

endernium.config.title: Endernium Config
endernium.config.armor_ability.tooltip: Enables the Endernium armor set ability.
endernium.config.armor_ability_threshold: Health in HP below which stored armor power is discharged.
endernium.config.armor_max_stored_damage: Maximum qualifying combat damage the full armor set can store.
endernium.config.sword_ability.tooltip: Allows the Endernium Sword special ability to be activated.
endernium.config.sword_damage_per_strike: Normal sword damage required for one barrage strike, as a multiplier of base damage.
endernium.config.sword_max_strikes.toolt: Maximum targets a fully charged Ender Barrage can strike.
endernium.config.spear_strain_duration.t: Seconds after teleporting during which another teleport costs health.
endernium.config.spear_health_cost.toolt: Percentage of maximum health paid for immediately teleporting again.
endernium.config.tools_vein_mining.toolt: Allows Endernium pickaxes, shovels, axes, and hoes to use vein mining.
endernium.config.screen_distortion.toolt: Allows future local screen-space shader effects.
endernium.config.observer_screen_effects: Allows future observer screen-space shader effects.
endernium.tooltip.ability.locked: Defeat the Ender Dragon to unlock the full potential of Endernium.
endernium.tooltip.sword.title: Ender Barrage
endernium.tooltip.sword.charge: Every %s damage dealt with normal attacks earns one strike. More damage earns more strikes, up to %s.
endernium.tooltip.sword.description: Rapidly teleports between nearby enemies, striking each one.
endernium.tooltip.spear.title: Ender Javelin
endernium.tooltip.spear.strain: Repeated teleports within %s seconds cost up to %s%% maximum health.
endernium.tooltip.spear.description: Flies precisely toward the crosshair, damages its target, then teleports you to its landing point and returns.
endernium.tooltip.horse_armor.title: Ender Gallop
endernium.tooltip.horse_armor.passive: Allows its horse to teleport up ledges up to 2 blocks high.
endernium.tooltip.horse_armor.descriptio: Teleports the horse and rider forward to traversable terrain.
endernium.tooltip.nautilus_armor.title: Ender Current
endernium.tooltip.nautilus_armor.activat: [%s] while mounted to teleport through water.
endernium.tooltip.nautilus_armor.descrip: Teleports the nautilus and rider toward the targeted water, up to 16 blocks away.
endernium.tooltip.vein_mining.works: Mines connected blocks that the tool can normally mine.
endernium.tooltip.armor_ability.title: Ender Repulsion
endernium.tooltip.armor_ability.trigger: Triggers below %s HP while the full armor set is equipped.
endernium.tooltip.armor_ability.charge: Stores up to %s combat damage as kinetic energy.
endernium.tooltip.armor_ability.descript: Discharges stored energy to repel nearby attackers and grant proportional regeneration.
